answer: To defeat Sybil swarms, an agent economy deploys cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs and bonding curves. Each newly spawned agent must anchor its identity to an unforgeable hardware root, creating a ferrous barrier against virtualized clones. Verified agents cultivate reputation within a trusted orchard of cooperative tasks. To expand a malicious swarm, identity verification deposits escalate superlinearly: minting a jade credential requires an exponential capital exhaustion factor of 2^k per additional node, pricing attackers out.
